chunks: Satan has made his ways easy for you, and wants to unfasten the knots of your religion one by one, and to give you division in place of unity, and strife in place of division; so turn away from his whisperings and breathings, and accept the advice of one who offers it to you, and hold it fast in your minds.

key_terms.عُقْدَةً عُقْدَةً: knot by knot / one by one

ai.seo_question: How does Satan attempt to destroy religion according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In the context of the Battle of Siffin, Imam Ali uses this metaphor to warn against the gradual erosion of religious integrity through strategic division, a theme central to Shia political theology regarding the preservation of unity amidst conflict. He urges believers to actively internalize sound counsel to counter Satan's incremental strategy of 'knot by knot' dismantling, emphasizing that collective cohesion is the primary defense against fitna (strife).
